visualCharacteristics: New: image gallery slider showing 2 slides per view, each image with a grey caption bar below, prev/next circular arrows top right and dot pagination below.
contentPattern: Interactive slider with arrows and dots.

usage.description: Photo gallery slider: each slide is an image with a caption bar; 2 slides per view on tablet and desktop, 1 on mobile, with prev/next buttons and dot pagination.

reuseGuidance: Use for photo galleries with short captions. Use the standard carousel for full-width hero slides with text overlaid on the image.
tableStructure: One row per slide: cell 1 image, cell 2 caption text
